description: Reviews a pull request when it opens or gets new commits: the structure checks, the UI copy rules and correctness at once. Night Shift then posts one comment, and a label when a problem blocks the merge.

inputs.name: pr
inputs.label: Pull request
inputs.description: The number of the pull request, for example 42.

nodes.label: Check out the pull request
nodes.command:
# Checks out the pull request and saves its diff in the project copy, for the reviewers to read.
set -e
pr="{{pr}}"
gh pr checkout "$pr" --detach
base=$(gh pr view "$pr" --json baseRefName --jq .baseRefName)
git fetch origin "$base"
mkdir -p .nightshift-review
diff=".nightshift-review/pr-$pr.diff"
git diff FETCH_HEAD...HEAD > "$diff"
files=$(git diff --name-only FETCH_HEAD...HEAD | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
echo "Pull request $pr changes $files files against $base."
gh pr view "$pr" --json number,title,url,headRefOid,baseRefName \
	--jq "{number, title, url, sha: .headRefOid, base: .baseRefName, files: $files, diff: \"$diff\"}" > "$NS_OUTPUT"

exits.name: fail
exits.description: The pull request could not be checked out.

nodes.label: Structure checks
nodes.command:
# Runs the layer and vertical checks. Their findings are data: the step ends checked either way.
bun install --frozen-lockfile > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Could not install the dependencies."
layers=$(bun scripts/check-layers.ts 2>&1)
layers_code=$?
verticals=$(bun scripts/check-verticals.ts 2>&1)
verticals_code=$?
printf '%s\n\n%s\n' "$layers" "$verticals"
LAYERS="$layers" VERTICALS="$verticals" PASSED="$layers_code$verticals_code" bun -e '
const { LAYERS = "", VERTICALS = "", PASSED } = process.env;
console.log(JSON.stringify({
	passed: PASSED === "00",
	report: [LAYERS, VERTICALS].join("\n\n").trim(),
}));
' > "$NS_OUTPUT"

nodes.label: Review the UI copy
nodes.prompt:
Review pull request #{{pr}} of this repository: {{checkout.data.title}}.

Read the section "UI copy: guide the person, hide the internals" in AGENTS.md, and docs/glossary.md. Then read the diff in {{checkout.data.diff}}.

Check every visible string the diff adds or changes: titles, descriptions, hints, placeholders, empty states, tooltips, toasts, aria-labels, push notifications and the messages the server sends to the UI. Report each string that breaks a rule: internals shown to a person, a word that is not in the glossary, a sentence over 20 words, passive voice, a semicolon or a contraction. Give a better text for each.

Change no files. Report an empty list when every string follows the rules.

outcomes.name: reviewed
outcomes.description: The review is done, with or without findings.

text.description: The string as the diff has it.

nodes.label: Review for correctness
nodes.prompt:
Review pull request #{{pr}} of this repository for correctness: {{checkout.data.title}}.

Read AGENTS.md and docs/steering/STRUCTURE.md, then the diff in {{checkout.data.diff}}. Read the files around a change when you need more context.

Look for bugs: wrong logic, a case the code does not handle, a race, a missing migration step, a test that does not test what it says, an error that is swallowed. Mark a finding blocking when it must be fixed before the merge, else minor. Do not report style: the checks do that.

Change no files. Report an empty list when you find nothing.

outcomes.name: reviewed
outcomes.description: The review is done, with or without findings.

nodes.label: Merge the findings
Does it block the merge?

options.name: blocking
options.description: A finding must be fixed before the merge.

nodes.label: Post the review
nodes.command:
# Posts one comment with the findings. A blocking review also gets the label needs-changes.
set -e
pr="{{pr}}"
verdict="{{triage.outcome}}"
if [ "$verdict" = blocking ]; then
	head="Night Shift found problems that block this pull request."
else
	head="Night Shift found nothing that blocks this pull request."
fi
body=$(printf '%s\n\n%s\n\n%s\n' "$head" "{{merge.data.text}}" "{{triage.note}}")
gh pr comment "$pr" --body "$body"
if [ "$verdict" = blocking ]; then
	gh label create needs-changes --color D93F0B --description "Night Shift found a problem that blocks the merge" 2>/dev/null || true
	gh pr edit "$pr" --add-label needs-changes
	echo '{"outcome": "blocked"}' > "$NS_OUTPUT"
else
	gh pr edit "$pr" --remove-label needs-changes 2>/dev/null || true
	echo '{"outcome": "fine"}' > "$NS_OUTPUT"
fi

exits.name: fail
exits.description: The comment could not be posted.

nodes.label: Blocks the merge
nodes.message: Pull request #{{pr}} has a problem that blocks the merge

nodes.label: Nothing blocks
nodes.message: Pull request #{{pr}} has nothing that blocks the merge

nodes.label: Not posted
nodes.message: Could not post the review on pull request #{{pr}}

nodes.label: No checkout
nodes.message: Could not check out pull request #{{pr}}

sections.label: Review
sections.description: Three reviews at once. None of them changes a file.

sections.label: Report
sections.description: One comment on the pull request, and a label when a problem blocks the merge.
